# Field boundaries for Berlin / Brandenburg, Germany

Germany, Berlin/Brandenburg (parcels) field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Land Brandenburg. License: DL-DE-BY-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/latest/de_bb_block.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25833; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: tk10, id, collection, hbn, net_area, metrics:area, flik, kreis_nr, geometry, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_bb_block/collection.json
